name: FORGE Basics
description: Common FORGE (.fg) code templates and patterns

snippets.name: Comment
snippets.description: Line comment (no block comments in FORGE)
snippets.content: # This is a comment

snippets.name: Variable
snippets.description: Declare a typed, mutable variable
snippets.content:
var x: int = 42
var name: str = "FORGE"

snippets.name: Constant
snippets.description: Declare an immutable constant
snippets.content: const MAX_RETRIES: int = 5

snippets.name: Type Alias
snippets.description: Give an existing type a new name
snippets.content: type Degrees = float

snippets.name: Print
snippets.description: Print to stdout, with and without a trailing newline
snippets.content:
print("Hello")
print_raw("no newline")

snippets.name: Read Input
snippets.description: Read a line from stdin
snippets.content: var line: str = read_line()

snippets.name: If/Elif/Else
snippets.description: Conditional statement (no truthiness — compare explicitly)

snippets.name: For/Range Loop
snippets.description: Range-based for loop (half-open)
snippets.content:
for i in range(0, 10):
    print(i)

snippets.name: For Loop with Step
snippets.description: Countdown using a 3-argument range
snippets.content:
for i in range(10, 0, -1):
    print(i)

snippets.name: For Each
snippets.description: Iterate over an array
snippets.content:
for item in collection:
    process(item)

snippets.name: While Loop
snippets.description: Condition-based loop
snippets.content:
while i < 10:
    i += 1

snippets.name: Infinite Loop
snippets.description: Loop until an explicit break

snippets.name: Proc (Function)
snippets.description: Define a procedure with typed params and return
snippets.content:
proc add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b

snippets.name: Void Proc
snippets.description: A procedure with no return value
snippets.content:
proc greet() -> void:
    print("Hello!")

snippets.name: Proc with Ref Params
snippets.description: Pass parameters by reference
snippets.content:
proc swap(a: ref int, b: ref int) -> void:
    var tmp: int = a
    a = b
    b = tmp

swap(ref x, ref y)

snippets.name: Main Entry Point
snippets.description: Program entry point
snippets.content:
proc main() -> void:
    print("Hello, World!")

snippets.name: Record
snippets.description: Define and instantiate a plain data record
snippets.content:
record Point:
    x: int
    y: int

var p: Point = Point { x: 10, y: 20 }
print(p.x)

snippets.name: Array
snippets.description: Fixed and dynamic arrays
snippets.content:
var coords: [float; 3] = [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]

var log: []str = []
append(log, "event one")
var n: int = len(log)

snippets.name: Map
snippets.description: Declare a map and check/access a key

snippets.name: Optional Type
snippets.description: FORGE has no null — use ?T with some/none

snippets.name: String Operations
snippets.description: Concatenation and common string built-ins
snippets.content:
var greeting: str = hello + ", " + world + "!"
print(len(hello))
print(trim(greeting))
print(contains(greeting, "World"))

snippets.name: Panic/Assert
snippets.description: Abort on an unrecoverable error or invariant violation

snippets.name: Function Returning Optional
snippets.description: Use ?T to signal a recoverable absence of a value

snippets.name: Import
snippets.description: Import another module and an aliased module
snippets.content:
import sensors
import nmea_parser as nmea

snippets.name: Export
snippets.description: Export a record, const, or proc for use by other modules

snippets.name: Channel (pub/sub)
snippets.description: Declare a channel and emit/receive events
snippets.content:
channel depth_reading: float

emit depth_reading -> 12.5

on depth_reading as value:
    print("Depth: " + str(value))

snippets.name: Operators Reference
snippets.description: Arithmetic, comparison, logical, and range operators
snippets.content:
# Arithmetic: + - * / %
# Comparison: == != < > <= >=
# Logical:    and or not
# Range:      0..10 (exclusive)  0..=10 (inclusive)
